name: Should I choose custom built-in bathroom cabinetry or store-bought units?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose custom built-in bathroom cabinetry or store-bought units?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom built-in bathroom storage maximizes every square inch of available wall space, while store-bought cabinets offer lower initial cost with fixed dimensions. In tight Aurora and Denver home bathrooms, off-the-shelf vanities and cabinets often leave awkward gaps that collect dust and moisture. Custom carpentry allows you to tailor linen cabinets, recessed medicine cabinets, and floating vanities directly to your room's exact stud layout and plumbing positions. While premade units install faster, custom finish carpentry delivers a seamless, high-end fit that matches your home's exact architectural molding.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom built-ins maximize awkward spaces and fit exact wall dimensions, while store-bought units cost less upfront but leave unusable gaps.
